name: Y2K streetwear drop poster
tagline: Poster-as-landing-page for a streetwear label — massive beveled slab-serif wordmark, chest-up character hero, DIY vinyl-sticker collage, vivid gradient. Y2K skate-surf energy on a fixed, reusable layout.
description: How to prompt an image model for a vivid, character-driven brand poster that reads like a 90s arcade / cereal-box drop announcement. Covers the fixed top-to-bottom architecture (top banner -> massive 3D-bevel wordmark -> ~60% chest-up hero with an original chest glyph and a prop at mouth level -> 3 scattered vinyl stickers -> condensed headline + italic-serif body + CTA pill -> thin footer strip) and the swap slots (brand, exclamation word, hero, product, palette, original blob glyph, aesthetic). Pairs with the /poster skill — the skill is the workflow, this guideline is the prompt-register reference.
